title: Cancel draft invoice
purpose: Record why an internal draft is no longer needed, keeping its billing snapshot, source lines and history available.
summary: Record why an internal draft is no longer needed, keeping its billing snapshot, source lines and history available.

tasks.title: Cancel the active draft
steps: Select [[Cancel draft invoice]] to preserve the record as Cancelled.

tasks.title: Keep the draft active
steps: Select [[Cancel]] or close the form without saving.

good_to_know: Cancellation keeps every line, including manual tax assessments, the total and history. It does not delete the record.
The order can have a new active draft after cancellation, using its current tests and prices.
This does not cancel a chain of custody, sample, test, quote or issued report.
A changed or already cancelled draft is refused; reload and review its current state.

sections.title: Access and purpose
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators can open or change draft invoices. Other staff and client accounts are refused, including direct links. These are internal USD billing worksheets. They cannot be issued or paid and are not visible in the client portal. Tax, due dates, payments and accounting entries are not calculated automatically. Staff may record explicit tax assessments on an active draft.

items.label: Keep the record
items.description: Identifies the draft being cancelled and explains that a replacement can be created from the source order.

items.label: Reason for cancellation
items.description: Required explanation, up to 2000 characters; saved with the actor and time.

items.label: Cancel draft invoice
items.description: Changes an active draft to Cancelled after rechecking its revision. The snapshot, total and audit history remain; there is no payment, credit note or ledger action. Opening this form for an already-cancelled draft returns to its detail page; a cancellation that happens after opening is still rechecked on submit.

items.label: Replacement draft
items.description: Return to the source chain of custody and select New draft invoice. Choose an active list covering every received test or an accepted quote matching all received tests and quantities.

items.label: Errors and concurrent changes
items.description: Errors appear above the form or beside the field, with submitted values preserved. A source or revision change requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying. No partial draft or audit event is saved on failure.

items.label: Cancel / Close form
items.description: Leave without saving. A dialog with changed input offers Keep editing or Discard changes. This ordinary Cancel action does not cancel an existing draft invoice.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size / Try again
items.description: Resize a dialog without saving, or retry a failed dialog load. On narrow screens the dialog uses the full screen. Wait for saving to finish before continuing.

items.label: Draft invoices / draft number
items.description: Breadcrumb links return to the directory or draft record without saving.

sections.title: Retained due date
paragraphs: Cancellation retains any staff-entered due date and its change history. A cancelled draft cannot be edited. The date is internal billing preparation and does not establish a balance due.

sections.title: Explicit tax assessments
paragraphs: Tax assessments are entered manually on an active draft through Add fee, discount or tax. Each requires a description identifying its basis or source, quantity exactly 1 and a nonnegative whole-cent USD amount. Multiple assessments may be separate lines. Tax lines have no quote, sample or requested-test source. Creation from a price list or accepted quote never creates a tax line.

There are no tax rates, taxability or exemption decisions, or automatic tax calculations. The exact draft total includes every entered assessment. Changing test, fee or discount charges never recalculates tax: review each tax assessment separately after changing charges. Zero retains an explicit assessment; a missing tax line makes no tax determination. Tax lines cannot be deleted or change kind; correct an amount to zero with a reason. Cancellation retains the lines and their history.
